sets.comment: RRX and ONON are plainly wrong and the mega-caps swamp the few genuine peers.
Only the telehealth trio is relevant; the rest look like industry-code matches.
WW, TDOC and GDRX are reasonable, CHWY is a fair DTC subscription analog, but HALO is clearly wrong.
